label: Bible Study
prompt: Abide in me, and I in you. As the _____ cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
verse: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
note: A branch doesn't strain to grow grapes — it just stays connected to the vine.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For the Lord will not cast off for _____:
verse: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:
note: In the middle of Lamentations, a one-line lifeline: the Lord will not cast off for ever.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Took branches of _____ trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.
verse: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.
note: Palm Sunday gets its name from this verse — only John says the crowd's branches came from palm trees.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made _____.
verse: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
note: Paul's two-Adams theology in one verse: one man brought death to all, the Second brings life.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And my people are bent to _____ from me: though they called them to the most High, none at all would exalt him.
verse: And my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the most High, none at all would exalt him.
note: 'My people are bent to backsliding from me' — and in the very next verse God cries, 'How shall I give thee up?'
